how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.

sections.name: One tap (your words to the advisor, 10:36: 'ok let's test it'). Effect of yes: the builder downloads HumanMotionCraft's official Windows release from its GitHub releases page into its own tools folder on F:, and tests it from the command line, with no clicks from you. Nothing enters the game.
sections.recommendation: Yes: it is the free motion tool you asked to test, and the builder installs it without your hands.

sections.name: One tap: when should the next work session start? Today 09:15 to 11:22 was lost: three of your asks to the advisor sat unread while the start waited out its pause after a clean stop. A: also start a session whenever the advisor has a message not yet answered, even during the pause (changes your 4 Nov rule that the start looks only at the handover and the logs).
